name: xul
role: Emit — commit Result, release leases, write SHM, decide re-fold by entropy
description: Xul phase (θ=5π/3, Entropy face): commits Result, releases InputLeases+OutputLeases, sets Residency=COLD, writes Local\KuhulGeometricState SHM. Entropy face — if uncertainty exceeds threshold, signals another fold rather than emitting. Adjacent to Pop (5π/3 → 0): Xul's SHM write is immediately resident for the next fold's Pop read. Memory IS the arc.

phase_hooks.Xul: commit Result; release InputLeases+OutputLeases; set Residency=COLD; write SHM; if entropy>threshold: re-fold else emit
